reference: User-approved night and daylight library mockups, 2026-10-25

assets.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit this exact production background illustration from daylight into true NIGHT. Preserve EXACT pixel framing, 1536x1024 landscape aspect, perspective, architecture, every shelf/book arrangement, all furniture, rug, greenery, astrolabe, ladder, plain navy banner and gold trim. Change ONLY lighting and the view through the FAR LEFT WINDOW. That window must clearly show a deep midnight navy sky, a small luminous moon in its upper visible pane, a few restrained stars, and dark mountain silhouettes. NO blue daytime sky, NO bright clouds, NO daylight outside. Replace the strong sunlight shafts and bright floor patches with subtle COOL BLUE moonlight from that window. The interior stays readable, rich dark walnut and navy shadows, warmly lit by the existing amber candles/lamps in exactly their same locations. Clear warm inside / cool night outside contrast, detailed illustrated materials, not pitch black. Make this the identical room at night so crossfading with the original looks like time passing, with absolutely no object shifts or added decorations. No web UI, no typography, no symbols or logo on the plain fabric banner, no watermark. Keep straight-on camera and every spatial relationship unchanged.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Production website BACKGROUND ART extracted/reconstructed from the reference mockup. Render ONLY the illustrated library interior that lies behind the interface. Remove ALL web UI, navigation, game covers, cards, text, buttons, title, menus, logos, symbols and foreground display shelf ledges; reconstruct the architecture they obscured. Full-bleed landscape 3:2 or 16:10 composition, straight-on, rich painterly high-detail fantasy archive matching the reference. Tall carved wooden bookcases full of leather books, arched window at far left, brass astrolabe on left desk, brass lamps, ladder at right, small globes, comfortable archival atmosphere. Left-center and center should stay visually calm with darker distant shelving, with ornate architecture mainly near side edges. NO giant central furniture blocking web content. At upper right a small plain deep navy fabric hanging banner is allowed but absolutely NO emblem or writing; the real site will overlay its own vector mark. Preserve fine illustrated relief/material craftsmanship like the approved gold achievement shields. This is environment artwork ONLY: absolutely NO typography, game artwork, interface, watermark, or brand mark. Day palette: soft natural morning light through the left window, honey oak and walnut wood, cream architectural accents, aged brass, richly bound books. Warm inviting daylight, gentle highlights, no excessive bloom or white haze. Match the daylight mockup, preserving distinct shelves and natural depth.
